history.summary: IDENTITY: Generic name flagged with HIGH uncertainty - 'Kali Temple' matches several shrines around Kailashahar and no source ties this CSV row to a specific one. Best-supported referent documented here: the 'New Kali temple' listed on the Kailashahar Wikipedia page among the town's notable religious sites (alongside the Lakshmi Narayan temple, 14 Deities Temple of Rangauti, and Sringeri Sharada Peetham). Other candidates that could be the intended row: a Kali temple in Kailashahar's Kubjhar area (Laxmipur Gram Panchayat), which was vandalised in an October 2021 incident that triggered Section 144; and the Kalisashan Kali temple at the Kalisashan tea garden under Kailashahar subdivision. CSV town 'Kailashahar' is plausibly correct and district is Unakoti, but the specific temple is NOT pinned. Do NOT conflate with the famous Kamalasagar/Kasba Kali temple (~160 km south) or the Tripura Sundari Shakti Peetha at Udaipur.
